description: A Fabric mod for Minecraft >26.3-snapshot-4 that adds a dynamic 3D Render Scaling slider to the video settings. Upscale for crisp supersampling, or downscale for potential performance gains on GPU-bound systems all while keeping your GUI perfectly native. Supports both OpenGL and the new Vulkan RenderPearl engine!

mods.name: Polypheides Resolution Scaler
mods.description: Hack in resolution scaling for Vulkan SDL3
